newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for
Vessels: Al Hafizu loading 13,500 tonnes bagged sugar. Rio B loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Jag Vishnu loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Kitta loading 14,500 tonnes bagged sugar.
Waiting to dock, five vessels to load using big bags and two to load bulk.
Road: 281 trucks carrying sugar arrived on June 24.

Vessels: Alan, Fratziz, Daiana P, Tong Cheng, Turnstone, Fulvia and Efrem each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Tern loading 28,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, five vessels of which one to load bulk, the others unspecified. At Cargill private terminal, Woodpecker loading 16,000 tonnes bulk sugar. No vessels waiting to dock.
Stocks: 14,141 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
